title: 日本防卫大臣：1%上限长期束缚防卫预算，应优先需求
speaker: Shinjuro Kozumi

segments.en: And his first international TV interview, Shinjuro Kozumi, told us that Japan would be transparent about spending on new warfare methods to such as drones and AI.
segments.zh: 在他的首次国际电视采访中，木住晋次郎告诉我们，日本将在无人机和AI等新型作战方式的支出上保持透明。

segments.en: What I feel as defense minister is that because a 1% cap was securely in place for so long, we were unable to allocate funding to areas that truly needed it.
segments.zh: 作为防卫大臣，我的感受是，由于1%的上限长期牢固存在，我们无法将资金分配到真正需要的领域。

segments.en: The SDF has continuously had to endure this constraint. I want people to understand that first.
segments.zh: 自卫队一直不得不忍受这种制约。我希望人们首先理解这一点。

segments.en: If we look at what is genuinely required right now, the necessary gear and our personnel executing their duties with high morale, despite this harsh security landscape, I want to purely request what is truly needed first, rather than focusing on percentages or baseline numbers.
segments.zh: 如果我们看看当前真正需要什么——必要的装备和人员在严峻安全环境下保持高昂士气履行职责——我想纯粹地先请求真正需要的东西，而不是关注百分比或基准数字。

segments.en: What kind of figure that turns into is something to look at afterward.
segments.zh: 最终变成什么数字，那是之后才考虑的事情。
